# Now I have all the information. Let me parse the file names and create the necessary directories. The format is `<date>__<file_name>.<extension>` and I need to reorganize to `<file_name>/<date>.<extension>`.
import os

base_dir = '~/documents/work/meetings/'
file_names = [f.split('/')[-1] for f in files]

# Extract unique file_names (without date and extension)
file_base_names = set()
for f in file_names:
    # Format: <date>__<file_name>.<extension>
    parts = f.split('__', 1)
    name_with_ext = parts[1]  # <file_name>.<extension>
    file_base_name = name_with_ext.rsplit('.', 1)[0]  # <file_name>
    file_base_names.add(file_base_name)

print("File base names:", file_base_names)

# Create directories for each file base name
for file_base_name in file_base_names:

    response = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=access_token, recursive=True)
    print(f"Created {dir_path}: {response}")
